name: OpenAI MCP Extensions
description: Extends MCP servers and apps with ChatGPT-native features like sidebar entrypoints, file handlers, and composer mentions, for plugin developers.

skills.name: App Entrypoints
skills.description: Lets users open a plugin's MCP App from the ChatGPT sidebar or from a thread, including through deep links.

skills.name: File Extension Handlers
skills.description: Renders custom file viewers when users open a supported file type, with resource reads and writes.

skills.name: Composer Mentions
skills.description: Lets users search a plugin's resources from the composer and attach references to a message.

skills.name: Form Elicitation
skills.description: Extends MCP elicitation with thumbnails, option descriptions, suggested values, and resource selection.

skills.name: Structured Settings
skills.description: Exposes plugin settings that ChatGPT can read and update through a structured schema.
